Class MenuListener

java.lang.Object
helloworld.helloworld.controller.MenuListener
public class MenuListener extends Object
Handles menu actions triggered from the game menu. This controller updates the game model in response to user selections such as changing player names, ball speed, game target, pause state and restart.
Author:
Rama Houreh

  • Method Details

    • setExit

      public void setExit()
      Closes the application.

    • setAbout

      public void setAbout()
      Displays an information dialog about the application.

    • setGameLimit

      public void setGameLimit()
      Prompts the user to enter the target score needed to win the game. If the input is valid, the game target is updated.

    • setPlayerName

      public void setPlayerName(int playerNumber)
      Prompts the user to set a player's name. The selected player's name is updated if the input is valid.
      Parameters:
      playerNumber - player number, expected to be 1 or 2

    • setGameName

      public void setGameName()
      Prompts the user to set the game name. If the input is valid, the game name is updated.

    • setBallSpeed

      public void setBallSpeed()
      Prompts the user to set a new ball speed. If the input is valid, both horizontal and vertical movement speeds of the ball are updated.

    • setRacketSize

      public void setRacketSize()
      Prompts the user to change the racket height for both players. If the input is valid, both rackets are updated.

    • setSpeedIncreaseInterval

      public void setSpeedIncreaseInterval()
      Prompts the user to set how often the ball speed should increase. The value represents the number of bounces between speed increases.

    • togglePause

      public void togglePause()
      Toggles the pause state of the game. If the game is paused it resumes, otherwise it pauses.

    • restartGame

      public void restartGame()
      Restarts the game and redraws the game window.

    • saveGameToFile

      public void saveGameToFile()
      Saves the current game state to a file using the serialization service. The game is paused before saving.

    • loadGameFromFile

      public void loadGameFromFile()
      Loads the game state from a file using the serialization service. After loading, racket colours are restored and the loaded game replaces the current game in the controller.

    • saveGameToDatabase

      public void saveGameToDatabase()
      Saves the current game to the database through the controller.

    • loadGameFromDatabase

      public void loadGameFromDatabase()
      Loads the latest saved game from the database through the controller. After loading, racket colours are restored and the game is redrawn.
